notes.title: Armortale: Release!
notes.content:
Armortale went live today. I hope you will enjoy this small indie old-school platformer.

Grab it with 20% discount the first week and save some pocket-cash.


Thank you very much for the support and if you like the game, spread the word, that may help a lot.

- PixelABCD, author
